Darts Score Tracker

Darts Score Tracker — 501/301 countdown for two players with checkout suggestions, bust handling and leg tracking.

Double-in is not required. Dart scores are 0–60 (T20 = 60). Bull = 50 and counts as a double for checkouts.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick 501 or 301 and enter player names.
  2. Type each visit's 3 dart scores (0–60) and tick “final dart was a double” when it was.
  3. Submit — busts are handled automatically, legs are counted.
  4. Watch the checkout suggestion before each visit.

❓ Frequently asked questions

When is a visit a bust?

A visit busts if it scores more than your remaining total, leaves exactly 1, or reaches exactly 0 without the final dart being a double (bull counts as double).

How do I win a leg?

To win a leg you must reach exactly 0 with your final dart landing in a double segment — or the bull, which counts as a double.

What are checkout suggestions?

Before every visit the tracker shows the standard checkout for your remaining score (up to 170), computed from real darts math.
